title: Dashboard search 'sort' param must translate legacy/UI sort names to index fields
answers: Why does dashboard search return results in a random order?
Why does sort=viewed-recently-desc or sort=name_sort not sort anything?
How to support old /api/search sort names in the new dashboard search API
Sort capability violation metric is nonzero for dashboards resource
body:
Symptom: dashboard search results come back in arbitrary order, and grafana_index_server_search_capability_violations_total{capability="sort",resource="dashboards"} increments, when the 'sort' query param is an old /api/search name (viewed-recently-desc, errors-desc, alpha-asc, etc.) or the UI's legacy name_sort value, none of which name an actual index field.
Root cause: convertHttpSearchRequestToResourceSearchRequest in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go used to pass the raw sort string straight through (minus a leading '-') as the index Field name, so unrecognized spellings matched nothing.
Fix pattern: before building the Sort entry, run the raw value through a translation step (parseSortParam) that strips the '-' direction prefix, checks a small alias map for UI-only names, then falls back to the shared legacy-sort parser (pkg/services/search/sort.ParseSortName) which also recovers the implied direction for suffix-style names like '-desc'/'-asc'.
Constraints: names not found in the alias map or the legacy parser must be passed through unchanged (not rejected) so an actually-misspelled field is still reported by the backend's sort-capability check; this only applies to clients still sending browser-stored/bookmarked sort values, not to new index field names.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go convertHttpSearchRequestToResourceSearchRequest and any other endpoint accepting a 'sort' query param tied to the dashboards/unified search index.
says: Dashboard search results come back in random order
Sort by name or recently-viewed doesn't actually sort
Legacy sort parameters don't work in new search API
Search returns capability violation when sorting dashboards
Old /api/search sort names broken in new implementation
search: Dashboard search 'sort' query param must translate legacy /api/search and UI sort names (viewed-recently-desc, errors-desc, alpha-asc, name_sort, etc.) to actual index field names via parseSortParam in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/search.go before building Sort entries. The function strips '-' direction prefixes, checks a translation alias map, then falls back to pkg/services/search/sort.ParseSortName to recover implied direction from suffix-style names. Unrecognized names must pass through unchanged (not rejected) so the backend's sort-capability metric (grafana_index_server_search_capability_violations_total) correctly reports misspellings; omitting translation leaves results in arbitrary order. Applies to convertHttpSearchRequestToResourceSearchRequest and any dashboards/unified search endpoint accepting 'sort' param.
